name: Open Assembly
thesis: Open Raygen’s portfolio as a working engineering document, with the machine itself filling the canvas.
interaction: Drag and zoom SERV0, blend its enclosure into view, inspect the toolhead, and move down through DAVID and Stardance document sheets.
why: Raygen’s love of Onshape and building 3D printers becomes the interface itself, with real assembly imagery and honest engineering properties instead of a conventional portfolio.
